svg.title: Spring Boot full-stack architecture from NBA API to browser
svg.desc: A layered diagram showing how data flows from the NBA API through Spring Boot layers (Controller, Service, Repository) and PostgreSQL to the client

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is a REST client and how does it interact with a Spring Boot API?')
sendPrompt('What does a Spring Boot @RestController do and how do I write one?')
g.text: Receives HTTP requests · maps URLs to methods · returns JSON responses

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the @Service layer do in Spring Boot and where does business logic go?')
g.text: Business logic · win probability calculations · calls Repository or NBA API

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is a Spring Data JPA Repository and how does it connect to PostgreSQL?')
g.text: Talks to the database · save, find, query team stats · no SQL needed

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I connect Spring Boot to PostgreSQL using application.properties?')
g.text: Stores team stats, game history, predictions

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me an example Spring Boot RestController for NBA win probability')
sendPrompt('Show me an example Spring Boot Service class for calculating win probability')
sendPrompt('Show me a Spring Data JPA Repository interface for NBA team stats')

svg.text: Click any layer or file to learn more
